text_block_list.text: One night, in my room—
choice_data_list:
Alright, now to check over these 
documents...

text_block_list.text:
I picked up the file and flipped through 
page after page. Recorded inside was Sonon 
Elfie's physical data, handed over by 
Ryoka Tsurugi.

Processing every last shred of data, 
thinking it through, and clacking away at 
the keyboard. ...And the reason why is—!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
EVERYBOOODY!! ARE YOU GETTING YOUR 
EXERCISE IN!?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Hup!! —Greetings! A lover of sports, 
bridging the world with shining sweat!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's your thrilling, athletic UmaTuber, 
Sonon Elfie!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: This time's Elfie Challenge is... this!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"I Tried Undergoing a Full-Throttle 
Workout from an Active Umamusume 
Trainer"!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
And so, here is our special guest from 
Tracen Academy, Trainer <username>!! Welcome~~~!!

Right... Today, at the request of Ryoka 
Tsurugi and her team, I was scheduled to 
provide Sonon Elfie with a single day of 
training.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's pause here for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The opening looks good here. We will begin 
preparing for the main shoot now, so 
please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Once again, thank you so much for your 
help, Trainer.
choice_data_list: No, are you sure I'm good enough……?
No, are you sure I'm good enough……?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It's totally, completely fine!! Alongside 
<chrname>-san, you're one of the most talked-about 
figures right now!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, I initially reached out to 
Elfie's former Trainer... and they 
wholeheartedly insisted that you were the 
right person for the job.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
The purpose of this session is to showcase 
Elfie tackling high-level training, 
allowing everyone to truly appreciate her 
exceptional physical prowess once more.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I will give it my ABSOLUTE all! Please, 
train me with everything you've got!!

...And with that, the video shoot began. I 
had Sonon Elfie work through each exercise 
I had carefully planned out the night 
before.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! First is high knees, and... Oh, 
you do quite a lot of training similar to 
this, don't you!
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I wanted you to get a feel for your 
iliopsoas muscles.

Yeah, I wanted you to get a feel for your 
iliopsoas muscles.

text_block_list.text:
Looking at Sonon Elfie's various 
metrics—especially the treadmill 
measurements—I noticed with slight concern 
that her cadence was on the lower side.

Perhaps because of her strong desire to 
dynamically use her body and put on a 
show... her stride rate doesn't seem to be 
keeping up with her broadened stride 
length.

Doing so increases the impact upon 
landing, placing greater strain on the 
legs and negatively affecting running 
form. Therefore—
choice_data_list:
I want to make picking up the pace today's 
goal.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I see!! Loud and clear! Alright, let's get 
cracking at full blast!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, there...!! T-This resistance band 
training... Really... hits... the 
spot...!!
choice_data_list:
Focus more on pulling your legs in toward 
your body!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Yeeees! Hnnnnnghhhh...!!
And thus, the training continued――

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ORRRRYAAAAAAAHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Ooooh?! The time, look at the time!! 
It's improved!! Ooooohhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, the video check looks good too. 
Thank you for your hard work, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Brilliantly handled. I am thoroughly 
impressed.
choice_data_list: No! Elfie's the one who worked so hard.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that as well, of course... but you 
too.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Even with your busy schedule, I can feel 
how earnestly and wholeheartedly you 
thought of Elfie before coming here today.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I was overwhelmed. So this 
is the gaze of someone who trains, 
supports, and guides active racing 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Just how clear and serene it truly was.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to express my deepest gratitude 
once more for your cooperation, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—And for that, I respect you from the 
bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
GOOD WORK, EVERYOOOOONE!! ...Huh? Wait, 
wait, wait?!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Trainer?! Your face is so 
red!? Is it heatstroke!?!?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, no, Elfie. It's my fault.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If you'd like, would you care to 
join the afterparty later?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It's a wonderful monjayaki place Elfie and 
I found. <chrname>, please come along with us!
